evidence: Quick Design-only truth review of design/design.md and design/contract.json. The native-authority, execution, failure, rollback, and privacy descriptions are internally navigable, but the terminal-projection count contradicts its own closed surface list.

findings.issue: The finalization procedure says it prepares all eight named terminal projections plus a redacted exports projection, while design/contract.json:547 already includes exports_terminal_evidence in its eight surface_ids and the contract repeatedly requires exactly 8/8 projections.
findings.why: This is a falsifiable reference contradiction at the implementation boundary: a reader can reasonably implement nine projections from the procedure or eight from the closed schema and acceptance targets.
findings.suggestion: State one cardinality consistently. Prefer saying that the eight named terminal projections include the redacted exports projection, and make the matching prepare text in design/contract.json:548 use the same wording.
